rulesStrings.li: r_text(aspiredStar!=false)->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Daylily · Silverstar, greets you friendly. In the familiar conversation, you can feel that she seems to have no defenses against you at all, as if you and her have long been a pair of old friends.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Hyacinth · Baka, greets you in a serious manner. However, having never experienced external affairs, her cute voice, deliberately serious to maintain the image of the Golden Iris Empire, always makes you feel she is a bit silly.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Snowflake Prism · Cosmos, greets you kindly. In just a few sentences, she shifts the topic from your greetings to what her research was about yesterday, but unfortunately, her disjointed and chaotic word order makes it difficult for you to understand what she is trying to say.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Night Seagrass · Mist, greets you with curiosity and friendliness. In your conversation with her, you learn that she is currently handling a special research target arranged for her by the head of the Research Department. This obedient and tolerant attitude makes you a little curious, but Night Seagrass tells you that sometimes, there is no need for too much utilitarianism between friends.\nOf course, except when learning wonderful code knowledge and clearing bugs.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Thale Cress · Mithril Creed, earnestly asks what kind of help you need. The constant sound of instruments makes you realize that you seem to have interrupted Thale Cress's experiment, but she doesn't seem to mind at all.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Dandelion · Wildheart, curiously asks about your needs and enthusiastically introduces his newly developed wonderful gadget. However, your crisis instinct tells you that there is probably, possibly, absolutely something wrong with this thing.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Jacaranda · Forget-me-not, greets you calmly. In the communication, she introduces the research she is currently conducting and her expectations for the beautiful future this research will bring. However, you feel that what she says seems a bit too profound.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Coconut · Farlook Grass, greets you with some confusion. She seems to be in the middle of studying some theory but was suddenly interrupted by you.\nAfter a brief moment of confusion, Coconut quickly comes to her senses, expresses a slight apology, and then welcomes you again in a formal manner.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Sunflower · Poetic Drama, greets you enthusiastically. However, beneath the enthusiastic appearance, you always feel a hint of exhaustion in her voice. But when you ask about it, Sunflower replies nonchalantly: Only persistent determination can overcome the impossible problems.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Wildflower · Shiloh Grass, greets you cheerfully. She tells you that she is trying to improve the design of the unstable charge, although success is still far away.\nThis weapon has already caused too many accidents, so she hopes to make it a guardian's sharp blade, no longer an out-of-control hazard.\nShe believes she can succeed.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Stephania · Ironheart, greets you gently. Her soft and approachable tone suddenly gives you the urge to stay here and chat with her all day. She asks you about a faction, but unfortunately, you have never heard of the name.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Hops · Wildfang, greets you with a bit of restraint. You remember that she seems to be an orphan adopted by the court, but eventually became one of the research officers through her own efforts. Therefore, although her tone is slightly reserved, it doesn't make you feel too repelled.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Camellia · Freesia, jokes with you full of energy. You can hear the faint sound of instruments working in the communication, but Camellia's steady voice makes you realize that her work seems completely unaffected by chatting with you.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Mistroot Flower · Clearvine, greets you in a calm tone. She doesn't express much, just waits for you to state your needs. Your intuition tells you that her silence is not a form of pressure for any conventional purpose, but that she genuinely doesn't know how to continue the conversation at this moment.

r_text->Hearing your voice, the research officer on duty today, Three-Sleep Flower · Royalheart, greets you with impeccable courtesy. Although it was just a short chat of a few sentences, Three-Sleep Flower's flawless etiquette has already left a deep and friendly impression on you.
